description: Canonical record shape for the silent-locus agent-hunt corpus. Every JSONL record in data/ must validate against this schema. Human-readable rules live in schema/README.md; machine validation in scripts/validate_schema.py.

@timestamp.description: Event time, UTC, ISO-8601 with Z suffix. Must be parseable. When no event time is recoverable, the documented sentinel 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z is used together with labels.timestamp_source=fallback:no_recoverable_date. Never silently 'now'.

confidence.description: Analyst confidence, free-form but conventionally one of: confirmed, high, medium, low.

description.description: Human-readable one-line summary of the record.

created.description: When this record was created by the pipeline (UTC, Z).

dataset.description: Dataset slug; doubles as the Elastic index/layer name.

file.description: Relative path of the repo-local source artifact this record was materialized from (repo-root-relative like data/<collection>/raw/... or collection-relative like raw/...). Complements source_url (upstream URL); sha256/size_bytes describe the artifact's integrity.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 hex of the dataset's documented identity string. The identity string per dataset is recorded in its PROVENANCE.md.

labels.description: Dataset-specific fields live here, never at top level. Flat: values are scalars or arrays of scalars, never nested objects (ECS labels rule). Dotted keys (section.field) are allowed for namespacing.

matched_string.description: The exact string that matched, for grep/sweep records.

note.description: Analyst note attached to the record.

record_kind.description: Snake-case record class, e.g. wiki_event, relay_paste, venue_probe. Registered in schema/README.md.

retrieved_at.description: When the source artifact was retrieved (UTC, Z).

retrieved_via.description: How the source artifact was retrieved (e.g. wayback, live-get).

sha256.description: SHA-256 of a retrieved artifact body, when the record carries one.

size_bytes.description: Artifact body size in bytes, when the record carries one.

source_url.description: Primary source URL for this record, when one exists.

title: silent-locus corpus record
